name: STAPLE!
blurb: Austin's independent comics, zine and DIY-art expo, held each spring at St. Edward's University.

editions.venue: The Mabee Ballroom, St. Edward's University
editions.evidence: Homepage: 'STAPLE! 2027, will be April 10-11 in The Mabee Ballroom at St. Edward's University!'

notes: Only a one-line save-the-date has been posted for 2027 so far; the live 'Schedule' and 'Guests & Speakers' nav links still point to last year's pages ('/2026-schedule/', '/staple-2026-guests-speakers/'), confirming no 2027 guest list yet, so tickets/guestsPage are left blank. Cover uses the plain wordmark logo: the page's og:image is a crowd photo (explicitly to be avoided) and the only poster-style art on the page is past years' 'Staplegator' illustrations (2015-2019), not current key art.
